description: Find capabilities in ONE product by plain language. CALL listProducts FIRST; `product` must be spelled exactly as listProducts spells it. If `weak_match` is true, search again with `suggested_vocabulary` before invoking. Results are a shortlist: call describeCapability for the contract, then invokeCapability. query='*' lists all; page with `next_offset` until it is absent.

entity.description: Restrict to one entity (listProducts names them).

mode.description: Restrict to reads or writes. Omit to let the query decide.

offset.description: `next_offset` from the previous page, with the same query.

product.description: Product name, exactly as listProducts spells it.

query.description: Goal in plain language, or '*' to list every capability.

routing_token.description: Latest `routing_token` from listProducts or a clash refusal; send with `user_words` after a clash.

user_words.description: The user's own words, verbatim, naming the product or a term only it uses. Never paraphrase.

name: searchCapability
